common_registry_assertions.source: Frozen registry() helper asserts exact npm origin, redirect:error and method:undefined/defaultGET on every call.
common_registry_assertions.native: Mock asserts HTTPS/exact registry authority, GET with empty body, nonempty nonce, no-cache/no-store and no Authorization. Native HttpTransport uses concrete GET rather than the Fetch method:undefined surface.
common_registry_assertions.redirect_boundary: No redirect option is carried in HttpTransport; shipping NativeHttpClient forwards redirects without following, covered by existing runtime http_client::tests::local_http_reuses_connections_preserves_credentials_and_never_decodes_or_redirects. This batch does not rerun that separate loopback proof.

comparison_scope: All61 pure arguments/outputs/errors retained; successful JSON exact, metadata error messages exact. Original bare-throws assertions compare rejection only; extra captured Error class/message/detail is not claimed equivalent.
Native state tests execute real release_verify::preflight/verify and release_install::install_with against in-memory transport/command mocks. No captured reports or decisions are injected.
Exact admitted Artifact pointer reaches the installer; the original object-identity intent is represented by borrowed Rust reference identity.
Original installed-file fixtures and changed bytes are used. Commands only synthesize files inside owned Scratch paths, never execute npm or installed code in native tests.
All async native schedules have independent700second Tokio virtual watchdog because original maximum polling budget is600seconds. All tests start with paused Tokio time; no numerical timing claim.
Negative controls reject altered version order, altered provenance identity, success for invalid input, each original conflicting metadata field, changed tarball and installed bytes.
